name: Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-end electronic materials and application solutions in China and internationally. The company offers electromagnetic shielding film, thin flexible copper clad laminate, film resistor, and ultra-thin copper foils. Its products are used in 5G communications, chip packaging, high-energy density lithium battery anode materials, automotive electronics, and high-density interconnection boards. Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics Co.,Ltd was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
